entries.name: LinearMap.lie_apply_eq_of_lie_basis_eq
entries.docstring:
A `K`-linear map agreeing with the bracket on basis pairs agrees with the bracket
everywhere.
entries.snippet:
theorem LinearMap.lie_apply_eq_of_lie_basis_eq (b : Basis ι K L) (f : L →ₗ[K] L')
    (h : ∀ i j, f ⁅b i, b j⁆ = ⁅f (b i), f (b j)⁆) (x y : L) :
    f ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅f x, f y⁆

entries.name: LinearMap.lie_apply_eq_of_lie_span_eq
entries.docstring:
Same, from a spanning set rather than a basis (`LinearMap.ext_on` in place of `Basis.ext`) —
for generators that span but aren't worth packaging as an indexed basis.
entries.snippet:
theorem LinearMap.lie_apply_eq_of_lie_span_eq {s : Set L} (hs : Submodule.span K s = ⊤)
    (f : L →ₗ[K] L') (h : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, f ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅f x, f y⁆) (x y : L) :
    f ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅f x, f y⁆

entries.name: LadderSystem
entries.docstring:
A system of `d` independent ladder pairs on a `K`-vector space `V`: annihilation operators
`a i` and creation operators `ac i` (`i : Fin d`), satisfying the canonical commutation relations.
A physical system exhibits its own concrete operators as one instance of this (e.g.
`QuantumMechanics/HarmonicOscillator/LadderOperators.lean`'s `toLadderSystem`, via
`ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap`) and inherits every result in `LadderSystem/` for free.
entries.snippet:
structure LadderSystem (K V : Type*) [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (d : ℕ) where
  a : Fin d → Module.End K V
  ac : Fin d → Module.End K V
  comm_a_ac : ∀ i j, (⁅a i, ac j⁆ : Module.End K V) = if i = j then 1 else 0
  comm_a_a : ∀ i j, (⁅a i, a j⁆ : Module.End K V) = 0
  comm_ac_ac : ∀ i j, (⁅ac i, ac j⁆ : Module.End K V) = 0

entries.name: LadderSystem.assoc_leibniz
entries.snippet:
lemma assoc_leibniz (x y z : Module.End K V) :
    (⁅x, y * z⁆ : Module.End K V) = ⁅x, y⁆ * z + y * ⁅x, z⁆

entries.name: LadderSystem.assoc_leibniz'
entries.snippet:
lemma assoc_leibniz' (x y z : Module.End K V) :
    (⁅x * y, z⁆ : Module.End K V) = x * ⁅y, z⁆ + ⁅x, z⁆ * y

entries.name: LadderSystem.E
entries.docstring: The `gl(d)` bilinears `E i j := ac i · a j`.
entries.snippet: def E (i j : Fin d) : Module.End K V

entries.name: LadderSystem.lie_E
entries.docstring:
`E` satisfies the defining relations of `gl(d)`:
`[E i j, E k l] = δⱼₖ E i l - δₗᵢ E k j`.
entries.snippet:
theorem lie_E (i j k l : Fin d) :
    (⁅L.E i j, L.E k l⁆ : Module.End K V)
      = (δ[j,k] : K) • L.E i l - (δ[l,i] : K) • L.E k j

entries.name: LadderSystem.lie_single
entries.docstring: The matrix units satisfy the same relations, at the level of `gl(d)` itself.
entries.snippet:
lemma lie_single (i j k l : Fin d) :
    (⁅Matrix.single i j (1 : K), Matrix.single k l (1 : K)⁆ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) K)
      = (δ[j,k] : K) • Matrix.single i l 1 - (δ[l,i] : K) • Matrix.single k j 1

entries.name: LadderSystem.toGlHomLinear
entries.docstring: The `K`-linear map sending matrix unit `Matrix.single i j 1` to `E i j`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def toGlHomLinear (L : LadderSystem K V d) :
    Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) K →ₗ[K] Module.End K V

entries.name: LadderSystem.toGlHomLinear_single
entries.snippet:
lemma toGlHomLinear_single (L : LadderSystem K V d) (i j : Fin d) :
    L.toGlHomLinear (Matrix.single i j (1 : K)) = L.E i j

entries.name: LadderSystem.toGlHomLinear_lie
entries.docstring: `toGlHomLinear` respects brackets.
entries.snippet:
lemma toGlHomLinear_lie (L : LadderSystem K V d) (x y : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) K) :
    L.toGlHomLinear ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅L.toGlHomLinear x, L.toGlHomLinear y⁆

entries.name: LadderSystem.toGlHom
entries.docstring: The `gl(d)`-representation on `V` generated by a ladder system, bundled as a `LieHom`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def toGlHom (L : LadderSystem K V d) :
    Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) K →ₗ⁅K⁆ Module.End K V

entries.name: LadderSystem.toLieModule
entries.docstring: The companion `LieModule` instance.
entries.snippet:
lemma toLieModule (L : LadderSystem K V d) :
    @LieModule K (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) K) V _ _ _ _ _ L.toLieRingModule

entries.name: LadderSystem.N
entries.docstring: The number operator for mode `i`, `Nᵢ ≔ Eᵢᵢ = acᵢaᵢ`.
entries.snippet: def N (i : Fin d) : Module.End K V

entries.name: LadderSystem.lie_N_a
entries.docstring: `[Nᵢ, aⱼ] = -δᵢⱼaᵢ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma lie_N_a (i j : Fin d) :
    (⁅L.N i, L.a j⁆ : Module.End K V) = (-δ[i,j] : K) • L.a i

entries.name: LadderSystem.lie_N_ac
entries.docstring: `[Nᵢ, acⱼ] = δᵢⱼacᵢ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma lie_N_ac (i j : Fin d) :
    (⁅L.N i, L.ac j⁆ : Module.End K V) = (δ[i,j] : K) • L.ac i

entries.name: LadderSystem.lie_N_N
entries.docstring: `[Nᵢ, Nⱼ] = 0`: the number operators commute among themselves.
entries.snippet: lemma lie_N_N (i j : Fin d) : (⁅L.N i, L.N j⁆ : Module.End K V) = 0

entries.name: LadderSystem.totalN
entries.docstring: The total number operator, `∑ᵢNᵢ` -- the total excitation count across every mode.
entries.snippet: def totalN (L : LadderSystem K V d) : Module.End K V

entries.name: LadderSystem.lie_totalN_E
entries.docstring:
The total number operator is central in `gl(d)`: it commutes with every generator
`E i j`, not just the diagonal ones (contrast `lie_N_N`, which only says the diagonal `Nᵢ`
commute *among themselves*). Consequently any operator built from `L.totalN` alone --
in particular an *isotropic* Hamiltonian -- preserves `vacuumSpan` sector-by-sector for the same
reason `vacuumSpanLieSubmodule` does: it is `L.toGlHomLinear` applied to a central element of
`gl(d)` (the identity matrix), so it acts diagonally on the whole `gl(d)`-module structure.
entries.snippet: theorem lie_totalN_E (j k : Fin d) : (⁅L.totalN, L.E j k⁆ : Module.End K V) = 0

entries.name: LadderSystem.moveOneTo
entries.docstring:
`α` with one quantum moved from color `j` to color `i`. Only meaningful for `i ≠ j`; the
degenerate `i = j` case is handled separately by `N_word`.
entries.snippet: def moveOneTo (α : Fin d → ℕ) (i j : Fin d) : Fin d → ℕ

entries.name: LadderSystem.countWord_moveOneTo_perm
entries.snippet:
lemma countWord_moveOneTo_perm {i j : Fin d} (hij : i ≠ j) {α : Fin d → ℕ} :
    List.Perm (i :: (countWord d α).erase j) (countWord d (moveOneTo α i j))

entries.name: LadderSystem.E_word_countWord
entries.docstring:
The transfer formula: `E i j` moves one quantum from color `j` to color `i`, scaled by
`j`'s occupation number.
entries.snippet:
lemma E_word_countWord {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω) {i j : Fin d} (hij : i ≠ j)
    {α : Fin d → ℕ} :
    L.E i j (L.word (countWord d α) Ω) =
      (α j : K) • L.word (countWord d (moveOneTo α i j)) Ω

entries.name: LadderSystem.mapsTo_aeval
entries.docstring: A submodule invariant under an endomorphism `M` is invariant under any polynomial in `M`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mapsTo_aeval {W : Submodule K V} {M : Module.End K V} (hW : ∀ w ∈ W, M w ∈ W)
    (p : Polynomial K) : ∀ w ∈ W, (Polynomial.aeval M p) w ∈ W

entries.name: LadderSystem.exists_word_countWord_mem_of_ne_bot
entries.docstring:
A nonzero `E i j`-invariant submodule of `vacuumSpan L Ω n` contains an occupation-number
basis vector. A Lagrange-interpolation polynomial in the diagonal separator
`∑ᵢ(n+1)^i • Nᵢ` projects a nonzero element onto one of its basis components.
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_word_countWord_mem_of_ne_bot {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω) (n : ℕ)
    {W : Submodule K V} (hWle : W ≤ vacuumSpan L Ω n)
    (hWE : ∀ i j, ∀ w ∈ W, L.E i j w ∈ W) (hWbot : W ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ α : CountFun d n, L.word (countWord d α.1) Ω ∈ W

entries.name: LadderSystem.sum_eq_length_countWord
entries.docstring: The total occupation number matches the length of the canonical word representing it.
entries.snippet: lemma sum_eq_length_countWord (α : Fin d → ℕ) : (∑ c, α c) = (countWord d α).length

entries.name: LadderSystem.sum_moveOneTo
entries.docstring: Moving one quantum between two modes preserves the total occupation number.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_moveOneTo {i j : Fin d} (hij : i ≠ j) {α : Fin d → ℕ} (hj : α j ≠ 0) :
    (∑ c, moveOneTo α i j c) = ∑ c, α c

entries.name: LadderSystem.moveOneTo_self
entries.docstring: `moveOneTo` at the color it moves quanta *into* just increments that color's count.
entries.snippet: lemma moveOneTo_self (α : Fin d → ℕ) (i j : Fin d) : moveOneTo α i j i = α i + 1

entries.name: LadderSystem.moveOneTo_moveOneTo
entries.docstring: Moving a quantum from `j` to `i` and then immediately back from `i` to `j` is the identity.
entries.snippet:
lemma moveOneTo_moveOneTo {i j : Fin d} (hij : i ≠ j) {α : Fin d → ℕ} (hj : α j ≠ 0) :
    moveOneTo (moveOneTo α i j) j i = α

entries.name: LadderSystem.word_countWord_moveOneTo_mem
entries.docstring:
The atomic move: if `W` is `E i j`-invariant and contains the word for `β`, and mode `k`
is occupied, `W` also contains the word obtained by moving one quantum from `k` to any other
mode `l`.

entries.name: LadderSystem.word_countWord_hub_mem_of_mem
entries.docstring:
Every occupation-number word reaches the mode-`0` hub word, given `W`
is `E i j`-invariant and contains it. Proved by strong induction on the mass sitting outside
mode `0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma word_countWord_hub_mem_of_mem {hd : 0 < d} {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω)
    {W : Submodule K V} (hWE : ∀ i j, ∀ w ∈ W, L.E i j w ∈ W) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ α : Fin d → ℕ, (∑ c, α c) - α (⟨0, hd⟩ : Fin d) = m →
      L.word (countWord d α) Ω ∈ W →
      L.word (countWord d (fun c => if c = (⟨0, hd⟩ : Fin d) then (∑ c, α c) else 0)) Ω ∈ W

entries.name: LadderSystem.word_countWord_mem_of_hub_mem
entries.docstring:
The hub word reaches every occupation-number word, given `W` is `E i j`-invariant and
contains it. Proved by strong induction on the mass sitting outside mode `0` in the target.
entries.snippet:
lemma word_countWord_mem_of_hub_mem {hd : 0 < d} {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω)
    {W : Submodule K V} (hWE : ∀ i j, ∀ w ∈ W, L.E i j w ∈ W) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ α : Fin d → ℕ, (∑ c, α c) - α (⟨0, hd⟩ : Fin d) = m →
      L.word (countWord d (fun c => if c = (⟨0, hd⟩ : Fin d) then (∑ c, α c) else 0)) Ω ∈ W →
      L.word (countWord d α) Ω ∈ W

entries.name: LadderSystem.word_countWord_mem_of_mem
entries.docstring:
Connectivity: any two occupation-number words of the same total excitation number reach
each other, given `W` is `E i j`-invariant and contains one of them.
entries.snippet:
lemma word_countWord_mem_of_mem {hd : 0 < d} {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω)
    {W : Submodule K V} (hWE : ∀ i j, ∀ w ∈ W, L.E i j w ∈ W) {α α' : Fin d → ℕ}
    (hsum : (∑ c, α c) = ∑ c, α' c) (hmem : L.word (countWord d α) Ω ∈ W) :
    L.word (countWord d α') Ω ∈ W

entries.name: LadderSystem.vacuumSpan_eq_of_ne_bot
entries.docstring:
`vacuumSpan L Ω n` is `gl(d)`-irreducible. The only submodules of `vacuumSpan L Ω n`
invariant under every `E i j` are `⊥` and `vacuumSpan L Ω n` itself.
entries.snippet:
theorem vacuumSpan_eq_of_ne_bot {hd : 0 < d} {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω) (n : ℕ)
    {W : Submodule K V} (hWle : W ≤ vacuumSpan L Ω n)
    (hWE : ∀ i j, ∀ w ∈ W, L.E i j w ∈ W) (hWbot : W ≠ ⊥) :
    W = vacuumSpan L Ω n

entries.name: CountFun
entries.docstring: A degree-`n` count function on `d` colors.
entries.snippet: abbrev CountFun (d n : ℕ)

entries.name: countFunEquivSym
entries.docstring: Degree-`n` count functions on `d` colors biject with `Sym (Fin d) n`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def countFunEquivSym (d n : ℕ) : CountFun d n ≃ Sym (Fin d) n

entries.name: instFintypeCountFun
entries.snippet: noncomputable instance instFintypeCountFun {d n : ℕ} : Fintype (CountFun d n)

entries.name: card_countFun
entries.docstring: There are exactly `(d + n - 1).choose n` degree-`n` count functions on `d` colors.
entries.snippet: lemma card_countFun (d n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (CountFun d n) = (d + n - 1).choose n

entries.name: LadderSystem.pow_a_comm_ac
entries.docstring: Annihilation and creation operators of different colors commute at any power.
entries.snippet:
lemma pow_a_comm_ac {i c : Fin d} (hic : i ≠ c) (k : ℕ) (y : V) :
    ((L.a i) ^ k) (L.ac c y) = L.ac c (((L.a i) ^ k) y)

entries.name: LadderSystem.word_peel_eq_count
entries.docstring:
Exact annihilation: applying `a i` exactly `count i` times removes every `i`, scaled by the
factorial.
entries.snippet:
lemma word_peel_eq_count (L : LadderSystem K V d) (i : Fin d) {x : V} (hx : L.a i x = 0) :
    ∀ v : List (Fin d),
      ((L.a i) ^ (v.count i)) (L.word v x) = (v.count i).factorial • L.word (v.filter (· != i)) x
  | [] => by simp [word]
  | c :: v' => by
    by_cases hic : i = c
    · subst hic
      have hpeel

entries.name: LadderSystem.annMono
entries.docstring:
The joint annihilation monomial for a list of colors `cs` and exponents `α`:
`∏_{c ∈ cs} (a c)^{α c}`.
entries.snippet: def annMono (cs : List (Fin d)) (α : Fin d → ℕ) : Module.End K V

entries.name: LadderSystem.annMono_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma annMono_cons (c : Fin d) (cs : List (Fin d)) (α : Fin d → ℕ) :
    L.annMono (c :: cs) α = (L.a c) ^ (α c) * L.annMono cs α

entries.name: LadderSystem.annMono_eq_count
entries.docstring: Exact annihilation of every color in the list produces the product of factorials.
entries.snippet:
lemma annMono_eq_count (L : LadderSystem K V d) {x : V} (hx : ∀ i, L.a i x = 0) :
    ∀ (cs : List (Fin d)), cs.Nodup → ∀ (α : Fin d → ℕ) (v : List (Fin d)),
      (∀ c ∈ cs, v.count c = α c) →
      (L.annMono cs α) (L.word v x)
        = ((cs.map (fun c => (α c).factorial)).prod) •
            L.word (v.filter (fun y => !cs.contains y)) x
  | [], _, _, _, _ => by simp
  | c :: cs', hnodup, α, v, hmatch => by
    obtain ⟨hcnotmem, hnodup'⟩

entries.name: countWord_filter_finRange
entries.docstring: `countWord α` contains only colors from `List.finRange d`, i.e. everything.
entries.snippet:
lemma countWord_filter_finRange {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → ℕ) :
    (LadderSystem.countWord d α).filter (fun y => !(List.finRange d).contains y) = []

entries.name: encode_injOn_aux
entries.docstring: A base-`b` positional encoding is injective on tuples with digits `< b`.
entries.snippet:
lemma encode_injOn_aux : ∀ (d b : ℕ), 0 < b → ∀ γ γ' : Fin d → ℕ,
    (∀ c, γ c < b) → (∀ c, γ' c < b) →
    (∑ i : Fin d, γ i * b ^ (i : ℕ)) = (∑ i : Fin d, γ' i * b ^ (i : ℕ)) → γ = γ'

entries.name: countEncode
entries.docstring:
The base-`(n+1)` positional encoding of a degree-`n` count function; injective on such
functions.
entries.snippet: def countEncode (n : ℕ) {d : ℕ} (γ : Fin d → ℕ) : ℕ

entries.name: countEncode_injOn
LadderSystem.word_countWord_ne_zero
entries.docstring:
Every occupation-number state is nonzero: peeling every color's annihilation operator down to
the vacuum leaves a nonzero factorial multiple of `Ω`.
entries.snippet:
lemma word_countWord_ne_zero {Ω : V} (hΩ : L.HasVacuum Ω) (α : Fin d → ℕ) :
    L.word (countWord d α) Ω ≠ 0

entries.name: LadderSystem.hasEigenvector_word_countWord
entries.docstring:
The occupation-number states are the eigenvectors, at pairwise-distinct eigenvalues, of the
single diagonal operator `M := ∑ᵢ (n+1)^i • Nᵢ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma hasEigenvector_word_countWord {Ω : V} (hΩ : L.HasVacuum Ω) (n : ℕ) (α : CountFun d n) :
    Module.End.HasEigenvector (∑ i : Fin d, ((n + 1 : K)) ^ (i : ℕ) • L.N i)
      (countEncode n α.1 : K) (L.word (countWord d α.1) Ω)

entries.name: LadderSystem.linearIndependent_word_countFun
entries.docstring:
The occupation-number family is linearly independent because its elements are eigenvectors at
pairwise-distinct eigenvalues (`Module.End.eigenvectors_linearIndependent'`).
entries.snippet:
theorem linearIndependent_word_countFun {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω) (n : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent K (fun α : CountFun d n => L.word (countWord d α.1) Ω)

entries.name: LadderSystem.span_word_countFun_eq_vacuumSpan
entries.docstring: The occupation-number family spans `vacuumSpan L Ω n`.
entries.snippet:
lemma span_word_countFun_eq_vacuumSpan (Ω : V) (n : ℕ) :
    Submodule.span K (Set.range fun α : CountFun d n => L.word (countWord d α.1) Ω)
      = L.vacuumSpan Ω n

entries.name: LadderSystem.vacuumBasis
entries.docstring: A basis of `vacuumSpan L Ω n` indexed by degree-`n` occupation-count functions.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def vacuumBasis {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω) (n : ℕ) :
    Basis (CountFun d n) K (L.vacuumSpan Ω n)

entries.name: LadderSystem.vacuumBasis_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma vacuumBasis_apply {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω) (n : ℕ) (α : CountFun d n) :
    (vacuumBasis L P n α : V) = L.word (countWord d α.1) Ω

entries.name: LadderSystem.finrank_vacuumSpan_eq_choose
entries.docstring:
The dimension of `vacuumSpan L Ω n` is `(d+n-1).choose n`, the degeneracy of the `n`-th level
of a `d`-mode bosonic system.
entries.snippet:
theorem finrank_vacuumSpan_eq_choose {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω) (n : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank K (L.vacuumSpan Ω n) = (d + n - 1).choose n

entries.name: LadderSystem.finiteDimensional_vacuumSpan
entries.snippet:
lemma finiteDimensional_vacuumSpan {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω) (n : ℕ) :
    FiniteDimensional K (L.vacuumSpan Ω n)

entries.name: LadderSystem.vacuumSpan_ne_bot
entries.snippet:
lemma vacuumSpan_ne_bot {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω) (hd : 0 < d) (n : ℕ) :
    L.vacuumSpan Ω n ≠ ⊥

entries.name: LadderSystem.vacuumSpanSymEquiv
entries.docstring:
`vacuumSpan L Ω n` is linearly isomorphic to `Sym^n(K^d)` (realized as the free `K`-module
on `Sym (Fin d) n`), matching the natural monomial-type basis on one side to the occupation-number
basis on the other.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def vacuumSpanSymEquiv {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω) (n : ℕ) :
    (Sym (Fin d) n →₀ K) ≃ₗ[K] L.vacuumSpan Ω n

entries.name: LadderSystem.vacuumSpanSymEquiv_single
entries.docstring:
The isomorphism sends the basis vector for multiset `s` to the occupation-number state with
that multiset's count function.
entries.snippet:
lemma vacuumSpanSymEquiv_single {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω) (n : ℕ) (s : Sym (Fin d) n) :
    (L.vacuumSpanSymEquiv P n (Finsupp.single s 1) : V)
      = L.word (countWord d ((countFunEquivSym d n).symm s).1) Ω

entries.name: LadderSystem.HasVacuum
entries.docstring: A vacuum: a nonzero vector killed by every annihilation operator.
entries.snippet:
structure HasVacuum (Ω : V) : Prop where
  ne_zero : Ω ≠ 0
  ann : ∀ i, L.a i Ω = 0

entries.name: LadderSystem.word
entries.docstring: A word of creation operators applied to a fixed vector.
entries.snippet: def word (L : LadderSystem K V d) (v : List (Fin d)) (x : V) : V

entries.name: LadderSystem.word_cons
entries.snippet:
lemma word_cons (L : LadderSystem K V d) (i : Fin d) (v : List (Fin d)) (x : V) :
    L.word (i :: v) x = L.ac i (L.word v x)

entries.name: LadderSystem.word_perm
entries.docstring: A word depends only on the multiset of colors it represents, not their order.
entries.snippet:
lemma word_perm (L : LadderSystem K V d) {v v' : List (Fin d)} (h : v.Perm v') (x : V) :
    L.word v x = L.word v' x

entries.name: LadderSystem.word_peel
entries.docstring: Peeling: `a i` applied to a word removes one occurrence of color `i`, scaled by its count.
entries.snippet:
lemma word_peel (L : LadderSystem K V d) (i : Fin d) {x : V} (hx : L.a i x = 0) :
    ∀ v : List (Fin d), L.a i (L.word v x) = (v.count i) • L.word (v.erase i) x
  | [] => by simp [word, hx]
  | c :: v' => by
    have hcomm : L.a i * L.ac c
        = L.ac c * L.a i + (if i = c then (1 : Module.End K V) else 0)

entries.name: LadderSystem.E_word
entries.docstring:
How `E i j` acts on a word: removes one occurrence of `j`, adds one of `i`, scaled by `j`'s
count.
entries.snippet:
lemma E_word (L : LadderSystem K V d) {x : V} (hx : ∀ i, L.a i x = 0) (i j : Fin d)
    (v : List (Fin d)) :
    (L.E i j) (L.word v x) = (v.count j) • L.word (i :: v.erase j) x

entries.name: LadderSystem.N_word
entries.docstring: Words are eigenvectors of the number operator, with eigenvalue their own color count.
entries.snippet:
lemma N_word (L : LadderSystem K V d) {x : V} (hx : ∀ i, L.a i x = 0) (i : Fin d)
    (v : List (Fin d)) : (L.N i) (L.word v x) = (v.count i) • L.word v x

entries.name: LadderSystem.countWord
entries.docstring:
The canonical word representing a count function `α`: `α c` copies of color `c`, in
increasing order.
entries.snippet: def countWord (d : ℕ) (α : Fin d → ℕ) : List (Fin d)

entries.name: LadderSystem.count_countWord
entries.docstring: `countWord α` has exactly `α i` copies of color `i`.
entries.snippet:
lemma count_countWord {d : ℕ} (α : Fin d → ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    (countWord d α).count i = α i

entries.name: LadderSystem.sum_count_eq_length
entries.docstring: A word's length is the sum of its per-color counts.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_count_eq_length {d : ℕ} : ∀ v : List (Fin d), (∑ c : Fin d, v.count c) = v.length
  | [] => by simp
  | a :: v' => by
    have hcount : ∀ c : Fin d, (a :: v').count c = v'.count c + (if a = c then 1 else 0)

entries.name: LadderSystem.vacuumSpan
entries.docstring:
The `n`-th excitation-number sector generated by a vacuum: the span of all length-`n`
creation words.
entries.snippet: def vacuumSpan (L : LadderSystem K V d) (Ω : V) (n : ℕ) : Submodule K V

entries.name: LadderSystem.exists_ofFn_eq_of_length_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma exists_ofFn_eq_of_length_eq {l : List (Fin d)} {n : ℕ} (h : l.length = n) :
    ∃ w : Fin n → Fin d, List.ofFn w = l

entries.name: LadderSystem.word_mem_vacuumSpan_of_length_eq
entries.docstring: Any word of the right length lies in `vacuumSpan`.
entries.snippet:
lemma word_mem_vacuumSpan_of_length_eq (L : LadderSystem K V d) (Ω : V) {n : ℕ}
    {l : List (Fin d)} (h : l.length = n) : L.word l Ω ∈ vacuumSpan L Ω n

entries.name: LadderSystem.forall_toGlHomLinear_mem_of_forall_E_mem
entries.docstring:
`E`-invariance of a submodule extends to full `gl(d)`-invariance, by linearity off the
matrix-unit basis.

entries.name: LadderSystem.E_mem_vacuumSpan
entries.docstring:
`vacuumSpan` is closed under every `gl(d)` generator `E i j`. Unconditional: no
`FiniteDimensional`/spanning hypothesis on the ambient `V` is used or needed.
entries.snippet:
lemma E_mem_vacuumSpan (L : LadderSystem K V d) {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω) (n : ℕ)
    (i j : Fin d) : ∀ v ∈ vacuumSpan L Ω n, (L.E i j) v ∈ vacuumSpan L Ω n

entries.name: LadderSystem.vacuumSpanLieSubmodule
entries.docstring: `vacuumSpan`, bundled as a genuine `gl(d)` Lie submodule.
entries.snippet:
def vacuumSpanLieSubmodule (L : LadderSystem K V d) {Ω : V} (P : L.HasVacuum Ω) (n : ℕ) :
    haveI

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.potentialFunction_apply
entries.docstring: The potential function, expanded: `½m · ∑ᵢ ωᵢ²xᵢ²`.
entries.snippet:
lemma potentialFunction_apply (x : Space d) :
    Q.potentialFunction x = (2⁻¹ * Q.m) * ∑ i, (Q.ω i) ^ 2 * (x i) ^ 2

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.potentialFunction_continuous
entries.docstring:
The potential function for the harmonic oscillator is continuous, hence a.e. strongly
measurable.
entries.snippet: lemma potentialFunction_continuous : Continuous Q.potentialFunction

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.annihilationCLM
entries.docstring:
The annihilation operator for mode `i`, `𝐚ᵢ ≔ (√2)⁻¹(ξᵢ⁻¹𝐱ᵢ + i(ξᵢ/ℏ)𝐩ᵢ)`, where `ξᵢ` is the
characteristic length of that mode (`HarmonicOscillator.ξ`).
entries.snippet:
def annihilationCLM (Q : HarmonicOscillator d) (i : Fin d) :

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.annihilationCLM_apply_fun
entries.snippet:
lemma annihilationCLM_apply_fun (Q : HarmonicOscillator d) (i : Fin d) (ψ : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    Q.annihilationCLM i ψ =
      (√2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • ((Q.ξ i : ℂ)⁻¹ • 𝐱 i ψ + (I * Q.ξ i / ℏ) • 𝐩 i ψ)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.creationCLM
entries.docstring: The creation operator for mode `i`, `𝐚ᵢ⁺ ≔ (√2)⁻¹(ξᵢ⁻¹𝐱ᵢ - i(ξᵢ/ℏ)𝐩ᵢ)`.
entries.snippet:
def creationCLM (Q : HarmonicOscillator d) (i : Fin d) :

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.creationCLM_apply_fun

lemma creationCLM_apply_fun (Q : HarmonicOscillator d) (i : Fin d) (ψ : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) :
    Q.creationCLM i ψ =
      (√2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • ((Q.ξ i : ℂ)⁻¹ • 𝐱 i ψ - (I * Q.ξ i / ℏ) • 𝐩 i ψ)

entries.docstring: The canonical commutation relations for the ladder operators, `[𝐚ᵢ, 𝐚ⱼ⁺] = δᵢⱼ`.

theorem annihilationCLM_comm_creationCLM (Q : HarmonicOscillator d) (i j : Fin d) :

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.deriv_realGaussian
entries.docstring:
The real-valued Gaussian `exp(-‖x‖²/2)`'s coordinate derivative,
`∂ᵢ g = -xᵢ · g`.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_realGaussian (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    Space.deriv i (fun x : Space d => Real.exp (-2⁻¹ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)) x =
      -x i * Real.exp (-2⁻¹ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.stdGaussian_apply'
entries.docstring: `stdGaussian (Space d) ℂ`'s pointwise value is the real-valued Gaussian, cast to `ℂ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma stdGaussian_apply' (x : Space d) :
    (stdGaussian (Space d) ℂ : Space d → ℂ) x = Real.exp (-2⁻¹ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.deriv_stdGaussian
entries.docstring: The coordinate derivative of the standard Gaussian, `∂ᵢ Ω = -xᵢ • Ω`.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_stdGaussian (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    Space.deriv i (fun x : Space d => (stdGaussian (Space d) ℂ : Space d → ℂ) x) x =
      (-x i : ℂ) * (stdGaussian (Space d) ℂ : Space d → ℂ) x

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.momentumCLM_stdGaussian
entries.docstring:
The momentum operator applied to the standard Gaussian,
`𝐩ᵢ Ω = -iℏ·(-xᵢ)Ω = iℏxᵢ·Ω`.
entries.snippet:
lemma momentumCLM_stdGaussian (i : Fin d) (x : Space d) :
    (𝐩[d] i (stdGaussian (Space d) ℂ) : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) x =
      (I * ℏ * x i : ℂ) * (stdGaussian (Space d) ℂ : Space d → ℂ) x

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.diagEquiv
entries.docstring:
The diagonal rescaling of `Space d` by the characteristic lengths, `(Q.diagEquiv x) i = ξᵢxᵢ`.
Composing the standard Gaussian with its inverse turns the standard Gaussian's isotropic width into
the anisotropic width `ξᵢ` required by a vacuum of `Q`, whether or not `Q` itself is
isotropic (contrast `stdGaussian`/`hasVacuum_stdGaussian_of_forall_xi_eq_one` below, which only
covers `∀ i, ξᵢ = 1`).
entries.snippet: noncomputable def diagEquiv (Q : HarmonicOscillator d) : Space d ≃L[ℝ] Space d

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.vacuumGaussian
entries.docstring:
The vacuum Gaussian of `Q`: the anisotropic Gaussian `exp(-∑ᵢ(xᵢ/ξᵢ)²/2)`, `Q.diagEquiv`
applied to the standard one. Equals `stdGaussian (Space d) ℂ` exactly when every `ξᵢ = 1`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def vacuumGaussian (Q : HarmonicOscillator d) : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.vacuumGaussian_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma vacuumGaussian_apply (x : Space d) :
    (Q.vacuumGaussian : Space d → ℂ) x = Real.exp (-2⁻¹ * ‖Q.diagEquiv.symm x‖ ^ 2)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.diagEquiv_symm_basis
entries.docstring: `Q.diagEquiv.symm` applied to a basis vector rescales it by `(ξᵢ)⁻¹`.
entries.snippet:
lemma diagEquiv_symm_basis (i : Fin d) :
    Q.diagEquiv.symm (Space.basis i) = (Q.ξ i)⁻¹ • Space.basis i

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.fderiv_norm_sq_diagEquiv_symm
entries.docstring:
The Fréchet derivative of the anisotropic Gaussian's real exponent `‖Q.diagEquiv.symm ·‖²`,
at the CLM level (mirrors `fderiv_norm_sq_apply`, composed with `Q.diagEquiv.symm`).
entries.snippet:
lemma fderiv_norm_sq_diagEquiv_symm (x : Space d) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun x : Space d => ‖Q.diagEquiv.symm x‖ ^ 2) x =
      (2 • innerSL ℝ (Q.diagEquiv.symm x)) ∘L (Q.diagEquiv.symm : Space d →L[ℝ] Space d)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.deriv_realGaussian_diag
entries.docstring:
The real-valued anisotropic Gaussian's coordinate derivative,
`∂ᵢ g = -(xᵢ/ξᵢ²) · g`.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_realGaussian_diag (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    Space.deriv i (fun x : Space d => Real.exp (-2⁻¹ * ‖Q.diagEquiv.symm x‖ ^ 2)) x =
      -(x i / (Q.ξ i) ^ 2) * Real.exp (-2⁻¹ * ‖Q.diagEquiv.symm x‖ ^ 2)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.deriv_vacuumGaussian
entries.docstring: The coordinate derivative of the vacuum Gaussian, `∂ᵢ Ω = -(xᵢ/ξᵢ²) • Ω`.
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_vacuumGaussian (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    Space.deriv i (fun x : Space d => (Q.vacuumGaussian : Space d → ℂ) x) x =
      (-(x i / (Q.ξ i) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Q.vacuumGaussian : Space d → ℂ) x

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.momentumCLM_vacuumGaussian
entries.docstring:
The momentum operator applied to the vacuum Gaussian,
`𝐩ᵢ Ω = iℏ(xᵢ/ξᵢ²)·Ω`.
entries.snippet:
lemma momentumCLM_vacuumGaussian (i : Fin d) (x : Space d) :
    (𝐩[d] i (Q.vacuumGaussian) : 𝓢(Space d, ℂ)) x =
      (I * ℏ * (x i / (Q.ξ i) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Q.vacuumGaussian : Space d → ℂ) x

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.annihilationCLM_vacuumGaussian
entries.docstring:
Every `annihilationCLM i` kills the vacuum Gaussian, without an isotropy or unit-length
assumption.
entries.snippet:
theorem annihilationCLM_vacuumGaussian (i : Fin d) :
    Q.annihilationCLM i (Q.vacuumGaussian) = 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.hasVacuum_vacuumGaussian
entries.docstring: `Q.vacuumGaussian` is a vacuum for `Q.toLadderSystem`, without an isotropy assumption.
entries.snippet: theorem hasVacuum_vacuumGaussian : Q.toLadderSystem.HasVacuum (Q.vacuumGaussian) where

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.annihilationCLM_stdGaussian_of_xi_eq_one
entries.docstring:
Every `annihilationCLM i` kills the standard Gaussian, provided that mode has unit
characteristic length. Independent of `hasVacuum_vacuumGaussian`/`annihilationCLM_vacuumGaussian`
above: the hypothesis here is genuinely weaker (unit length in mode `i` alone, not every mode), so
this isn't a corollary of the general anisotropic result.
entries.snippet:
lemma annihilationCLM_stdGaussian_of_xi_eq_one (i : Fin d) (hξ : Q.ξ i = 1) :
    Q.annihilationCLM i (stdGaussian (Space d) ℂ) = 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.hasVacuum_stdGaussian_of_forall_xi_eq_one
entries.docstring:
`stdGaussian (Space d) ℂ` is a vacuum for `Q.toLadderSystem` when every mode has unit
characteristic length.
entries.snippet:
lemma hasVacuum_stdGaussian_of_forall_xi_eq_one (hξ : ∀ i, Q.ξ i = 1) :
    Q.toLadderSystem.HasVacuum (stdGaussian (Space d) ℂ)

entries.name: MState.uConj_spectrum_eq
entries.docstring:
You might think this should only be true up to permutation, so that it would read like
`∃ σ : Equiv.Perm d, (ρ.uConj U).spectrum = ρ.spectrum.relabel σ`. But since eigenvalues
of a matrix are always canonically sorted, this is actually an equality.

theorem uConj_spectrum_eq (ρ : MState d) (U : 𝐔[d]) :
    (ρ.uConj U).spectrum = ρ.spectrum
